title: Resolving tensor presentation for finite coefficient site descent
statement: At every positive finite coefficient level, take the full subcategory P of etale complexes whose termwise inverse images are intrinsically K-flat. Restriction along P times P to the product etale derived category is fully faithful on functors into the intrinsic derived category. The source localization tensorator on these representatives is the inverse of a natural isomorphism, whose components are the specified finiteHomEtaleTensorModel maps. The termwise inverse-image chain tensor comparisons assemble naturally and have exactly the specified finiteHomNuChainTensor components. The source representative predicate is the one in [lem-sf-etale-kflat-tensor-presentation].

source.place: Final site-transport paragraph; Stacks Project, Cohomology on Sites, Tags 06YN and 07A4.

proof.text: The resolving representative theorem gives the fully faithful restriction on pairs.

Reflect intrinsic K-flatness to etale K-flatness, then apply the etale K-flat localization presentation, whose inverse components are the specified representative maps. Retain the shared model-map carrier and its heterogeneous component certificate until generic descent, where its homogeneous instance is converted back to ordinary equality.
Use naturality of the specified pointwise chain tensor comparisons for the third assertion.

lean.statement:
theorem finiteHomNuTensorPresentation
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra ℚ_[l] E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E] (X : Scheme.{u}) (n : ℕ) :
    let K := CochainComplex (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology
      (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1, u}
        (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E (n + 1))))) ℤ
    let P : ObjectProperty K := fun P ↦
      @CochainComplex.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients.{u + 1, u, u + 1}
        X.ProEt inferInstance (essentiallySmallSelf.{0, u, u + 1} _)
        (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) (integralCoefficientCommRingSheaf l E X n)
        ((finiteHomNuComplex l E X n).obj P)
    let t : K × K ⥤ K := finiteHomCochainTensorGeneral _
    let Q := finiteHomEtaleQ l E X n
    let U := finiteHomNuComplex l E X n
    let S := (finiteHomEtaleClosed l E X n).tensor
    FiniteHomTensorPresentationAux (normalizedDVRDerived l E X n) Q U t
      (coefficientTotalTensor.{u, u + 1, u} (Scheme.ProEt.topology X)
        (integralCoefficientCommRingSheaf l E X n)) S P
      (finiteHomEtaleTensorModel l E X n) (finiteHomNuChainTensor l E X n)
lean.note: The comparison family retains its heterogeneous component equation through FiniteHomChainTensorNaturalityAux; the abstract uniqueness helper converts the equality certificate between native witnesses to ordinary equality. This shares the same data and does not weaken the presentation.
